## Curriculum / 课程内容

| English | 中文 |
|---|---|
| From questions to evidence | 从问题到证据 |
| Data, study designs, and bias | 数据、研究设计与偏倚 |
| Describing and visualizing health data | 健康数据的描述与可视化 |
| Probability and sampling variability | 概率与抽样变异 |
| Estimation and confidence intervals | 估计与置信区间 |
| Hypothesis testing and group comparisons | 假设检验与组间比较 |
| Frequency and association measures | 频率与关联性指标 |
| Screening and diagnostic tests | 筛查与诊断试验 |
| Correlation and regression basics | 相关与回归基础 |
| Reproducibility, equity, and ethics | 可重复性、公平与伦理 |
| Guided mini case study | 引导式小型案例研究 |

<div class="footer-note">
All records and results are simulated and contain no identifiable health information. / 所有记录和结果均为模拟数据，不包含可识别的个人健康信息。
</div>
